latest_release.name: MangoDisk 2.1.2
latest_release.body:
## 中文

- 优化**磁盘分析**性能，让浏览扫描结果更流畅
- 调整**深度清理**的推荐项和风险级别，方便判断哪些项目适合清理
- 扩展 **macOS 深度清理**，现可检测已下载的安装包、应用更新残留和 Hermes Agent 卸载残留
- 修复 **Windows 启动项**对部分含空格的程序路径识别错误的问题，以及**应用卸载**读取部分应用名称和卸载信息异常的问题
- 修复 **Windows 浮窗监控**在高缩放比例下显示不全的问题
- **Windows 资源管理器右键菜单**中的「复制文本内容」仅对符合大小限制的受支持文本文件显示
- **Windows 贴靠布局**的两种触发方式现在可以分别关闭（悬停在最大化按钮上、将窗口拖到屏幕顶部）
- **Linux** 新增 **NVIDIA GPU 监控**，可在系统概览和托盘面板查看显卡使用情况
- 扫描记录、清理历史等页面的**日期显示**现在遵循系统区域设置
- 为支持项目持续发展，推出 **MangoDisk 支持者计划**。官方云端 AI 解读现作为支持者专属权益提供，所有核心功能仍然免费、开源，自定义 AI 服务不受影响
- 修复其他已知问题，提升稳定性和使用体验

## English

- Improved **Disk Space Analysis** performance so you can browse scan results more smoothly.
- Refined **Deep Cleanup** recommendations and risk ratings to make it easier to decide what to remove.
- Expanded **Deep Cleanup on macOS** to detect downloaded installers, app update remnants, and files left behind after uninstalling Hermes Agent.
- Fixed issues with **Windows Startup Items** recognizing some program paths with spaces and **App Uninstaller** reading certain app names and uninstall details.
- Fixed clipping in the **Windows floating monitor** at high display scaling.
- The **Windows File Explorer context menu** now shows “Copy text contents” only for supported text files within the size limit.
- You can now turn off either **Windows Snap Layouts** trigger independently (hovering over the maximize button or dragging a window to the top of the screen).
- Added **NVIDIA GPU monitoring on Linux**, so you can check GPU usage in System Overview and the tray panel.
- **Date formats** in scan records, cleanup history, and other views now follow your system’s regional settings.
- Introduced the **MangoDisk Supporter Program** to support the project’s ongoing development. MangoDisk Cloud AI is now exclusive to supporters. All core features remain free and open source, and custom AI services remain available.
- Fixed other known issues and improved stability and usability.

detail.readme:
MangoDisk

Disk cleanup and storage analysis for macOS, Windows, and Linux

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Русский

## What MangoDisk Can Do > **Storage** ### 1. Deep Cleanup Find caches, build artifacts, and local AI models left by apps and developer tools, even in hidden folders. - **System and user caches**: Clear temporary system files, diagnostic data, and caches that can be rebuilt. - **Application caches**: Clear caches, logs, update packages, and temporary files left by apps. - **Browser data**: Clear caches and temporary web data from Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Arc, Opera, and other browsers. - **Developer tools and Xcode**: Clear caches from package managers, IDEs, and compilers, as well as Xcode development data. - **Container caches**: Remove unused build caches and other data that Docker and similar tools can regenerate. - **Project build artifacts**: Clean up regenerable dependencies, caches, and build directories from Node.js, Rust, Gradle, Swift, Python, .NET, Godot, CMake, and other projects. - **AI tools**: Remove caches, old logs, and temporary downloads from ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and similar apps. - **AI models**: Check how much space local models in Ollama, LM Studio, Hugging Face, and ComfyUI use. Choose which models to remove. You’ll need to download any deleted models you want to use later. - **Application optimization**: Reduce the size of supported apps while keeping them usable. Start with the recommended items or review them one by one. See how much space you can free before you clean. ### 2. Large File Cleanup Find the files taking up the most space, from old installers to videos and archives, without digging through folders. ### 3. Duplicate File Cleanup MangoDisk compares file contents to find exact duplicates, even when filenames differ. Smart selection keeps at least one copy in each group. ### 4. Disk Space Analysis #### Space Distribution See where your storage goes. Switch between a **treemap** and a **sunburst chart**, set the folder depth, and use the file list to drill down to the largest folders and files. #### Space Changes Wondering where your free space went? Turn on scan history and compare two scans of the same drive or folder to see what grew or shrank. Scan again after cleaning to check where you freed up space. > **Privacy & Security** ### 5. Privacy Cleanup Clear browsing and search history, cookies, recent items, and clipboard contents to remove traces of activity left by browsers, apps, and the system. > **System Tools** ### 6. Application Uninstall and Cleanup Remove apps along with their caches, settings, and leftover files. MangoDisk takes extra care with locations that may contain personal files. ### 7. Startup Item Management Disable startup items you don’t need to shorten startup times and reduce background activity. You can enable them again whenever you need them. ### 8. System Optimization Adjust system settings for better performance, more privacy, or a setup that suits the way you work. ### 9. System Maintenance Fix common issues with search, icons, audio, or network connections without troubleshooting manually or running commands. ### 10. Context Menus (Windows) Browse right-click menu entries by location or app. Disable, restore, or remove supported entries, and tailor menus to individual file types. Add shortcuts for everyday actions such as copying a path, opening a terminal, or launching system tools. > **Activity** ### 11. Operation History Review past cleanups and system changes. See how much space you freed, which actions completed, and what still needs attention. ## Resource Usage and Memory Management Track CPU, GPU, memory, network, and disk activity in real time. On supported hardware, check temperature, power use, battery status, and disk health. Find and quit apps using too many resources, or free memory manually or automatically. Keep an eye on your system from the menu bar, taskbar, system tray, or a floating desktop window. Choose which metrics to show and how they look. ## AI Explanations Unsure what an item does or what changing it might affect? Ask for an explanation next to the item. It uses the item’s description and scan results to explain its purpose and what to consider before acting. Available for built-in Deep Cleanup rules, Privacy Cleanup, Startup Item Management, System Optimization, and System Maintenance. ## Safety and Rules > [!IMPORTANT] > **MangoDisk puts data safety first.** > Cleanup rules and system optimizations ship only after their safe operating limits are defined and tested on real systems. Scans are read-only by default. Before cleaning, deleting files, uninstalling apps, or changing system settings, MangoDisk shows what will change and asks for confirmation. Results are saved to Operation History. System Optimization runs only built-in, tested settings. MangoDisk checks the setting after applying it and warns you beforehand about risks, administrator access, or a restart. MangoDisk maintains its own cleanup rules. Third-party projects can suggest areas to investigate. Each new rule is checked against reliable sources and tested on real systems before inclusion. The rules and their revision history are public. [Browse the MangoDisk cleanup rules](https://github.com/harry0703/MangoDisk/tree/main/src-tauri/crates/mangodisk-core/rules). ## Screenshots

Deep Cleanup
Clear built-up caches, build artifacts, and AI models you no longer need

Space Distribution
See where your storage goes and find the largest files and folders

Space Changes
Compare two scans to see where disk usage changed

System Monitoring
CPU, memory, network, and disk activity at a glance

Large File Cleanup
Find the files taking up the most space

 Duplicate File Cleanup
Remove exact duplicates and keep at least one copy per group
Startup Item Management
Disable startup items you don’t need

 Application Uninstall and Cleanup
Remove apps and the files they leave behind
System Optimization
Adjust system settings for performance, privacy, and everyday use

 System Maintenance
Fix common system issues
Privacy Cleanup
Clear activity traces left by browsers, apps, and the system
## Before You Begin > [!CAUTION] > > 1. Cleanup, permanent deletion, and uninstall operations may be irreversible. Check what you’ve selected and back up important data before continuing. > 2. Check what an item does and what may change before running system maintenance or adjusting startup items or system settings. > 3. Some system optimizations can affect security, privacy, battery life, or system updates. ## Desktop App Download MangoDisk from the [official download page](https://mangodisk.app/download) or [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/harry0703/MangoDisk/releases/latest), then follow the instructions for your operating system below. ### macOS **Requirements:** macOS Monterey 12.5 or later. **Install with Homebrew:** ```sh brew install --cask harry0703/tap/mangodisk ``` **Manual installation:** Download the DMG from the [official download page](https://mangodisk.app/download), open it, and drag MangoDisk into the Applications folder. ### Windows **Requirements:** 64-bit Windows 10 or later. **Install with PowerShell:** ```powershell irm https://get.mangodisk.app | iex ``` **Install with WinGet (official source):** ```powershell winget install --id MangoDisk.MangoDisk --exact --source winget ``` **Manual installation:** Download the Windows installer from the [official download page](https://mangodisk.app/download) and follow the installation prompts. ### Linux **Recommended:** Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or later, on x64 or ARM64. Available as `.deb` packages and AppImages. Compatibility with other Linux distributions depends on their system libraries and desktop environment. **Install with Homebrew:** Requires a recent Homebrew version and a desktop environment. ```sh brew install --cask harry0703/tap/mangodisk ``` **Install from the terminal (Debian/Ubuntu):** This command detects your architecture and installs the latest matching `.deb` package. ```sh curl -fsSL https://get.mangodisk.app/linux | bash ``` **Manual installation:** Choose the package for your architecture on the [official download page](https://mangodisk.app/download). - **Debian/Ubuntu:** Install the `.deb` package for your architecture. - **Other distributions:** Try the AppImage by making it executable, then running it. ## Command Line (CLI) Run MangoDisk from a terminal or a script using the same cleanup engine as the desktop app. ### macOS **Install with Homebrew:** ```sh brew install harry0703/tap/mangodisk-cli ``` ### Windows **Install with PowerShell:** ```powershell irm https://get.mangodisk.app/cli | iex ``` **Install with WinGet (official source):** ```powershell winget install --id MangoDisk.CLI --exact --source winget ``` ### Linux Prebuilt standalone CLI downloads are not yet available for Linux. Follow the [Build from Source](#build-from-source) instructions below to build it yourself. ### Usage Examples If `mangodisk` is not immediately available after installation, open a new terminal, then verify the installation: ```sh mangodisk --version ``` Common commands: ```sh # Scan and show cleanable content without changing anything mangodisk clean # Apply the same smart recommendations as the desktop application mangodisk clean --apply # Preview all selectable content without deleting anything mangodisk clean --apply --selection all --dry-run # Produce machine-readable JSON output mangodisk clean --format json --no-progress ``` `mangodisk clean` scans in read-only mode by default. For cleanup in a non-interactive environment, pass `--yes` to confirm. Run the following command to see all options: ```sh mangodisk clean --help ``` ## Build from Source ### Prerequisites - Node.js 24 LTS - pnpm 11.13.1 - Stable Rust For platform-specific dependencies, see the [Tauri 2 prerequisites](https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/). ### Get the Source and Run the Desktop Application ```sh git clone https://github.com/harry0703/MangoDisk.git cd MangoDisk pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm tauri:dev ``` ### Run the Required Checks ```sh pnpm check cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p mangodisk-core ``` ### Build the Desktop Installer ```sh pnpm tauri:build ``` ### Build the CLI ```sh pnpm cli:build ``` Local builds are for development and verification. Release signing, notarization, and update metadata are handled by the official release process. ## Support MangoDisk MangoDisk is free, open source, and ad-free. The core features are free for personal and commercial use under GPL-3.0. To support development and use MangoDisk’s hosted AI, [become a supporter](https://mangodisk.app/supporter). ## Contributing Issues, cleanup rules, fixes, and new features are welcome. Read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) before getting started. Routine cleanup coverage should use build-validated, declarative TOML rules. See [`src-tauri/crates/mangodisk-core/rules/README.md`](src-tauri/crates/mangodisk-core/rules/README.md) for the rule schema, safety constraints, and validation instructions. Before submitting changes, run at least: ```sh pnpm check cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p mangodisk-core ``` Report security vulnerabilities privately through GitHub Security Advisories as described in [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue for a security vulnerability. ## Technology Stack - [Tauri 2](https://tauri.app/): Desktop runtime and system integration - [Rust](https://www.rust-lang.org/): Scanning, filesystem access, safety validation, and cleanup execution - [Vue 3](https://vuejs.org/) and [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/): Desktop user interface ## License MangoDisk is open source under the [GNU General Public License v3.0](https://github.com/harry0703/MangoDisk/blob/main/LICENSE). Third-party components remain subject to their respective licenses.
detail.readme_zh:
MangoDisk - 芒果磁盘清理

适用于 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的磁盘清理与空间分析工具

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Русский

## MangoDisk 能做什么 > **存储空间** ### 1. 深度清理 日常应用、开发工具和 AI 工具留下的缓存、构建产物与本地模型，常常散落在各处，不知不觉就占满磁盘。MangoDisk 把它们集中找出来，省去逐个翻找隐藏目录的麻烦： - **系统与用户缓存**：清理系统临时文件、诊断数据和可重新生成的缓存，释放长期占用的空间。 - **应用缓存**：清理常用应用的缓存、日志、更新包和临时文件，避免它们越积越多。 - **浏览器数据**：清理 Chrome、Edge、Firefox、Brave、Arc、Opera 等浏览器的缓存和临时网页数据。 - **开发工具与 Xcode**：清理包管理器、IDE、编译工具产生的缓存，以及 Xcode 开发数据，快速释放空间。 - **容器缓存**：清理 Docker 等容器工具的闲置构建缓存和可重新生成的数据。 - **项目构建产物**：清理 Node.js、Rust、Gradle、Swift、Python、.NET、Godot、CMake 等项目中可重新生成的依赖、缓存和构建目录。 - **AI 工具**：清理 ChatGPT、Codex、Claude 等工具留下的缓存、旧日志和临时下载文件，无需逐个查找数据目录。 - **AI 模型**：查看 Ollama、LM Studio、Hugging Face、ComfyUI 等本地模型占用的空间，删除不再需要的模型。模型需手动选择；清理后如需再次使用，要重新下载。 - **应用优化**：在不影响正常使用的前提下，减小受支持应用的体积。 智能推荐可帮你快速选出安全的清理项。你也可以逐项确认，并在清理前查看预计可释放的空间。 ### 2. 大文件清理 快速找出最占空间的大文件，集中查看旧安装包、视频、归档文件等，不用再逐层翻目录。 ### 3. 重复文件清理 根据文件内容识别重复项，避免把同名但内容不同的文件误判为重复。智能选择会为每组至少保留一份，方便清理多余副本。 ### 4. 磁盘空间分析 #### 空间分布 直观看清磁盘空间的去向。可在**矩形图**和**旭日图**之间切换，自定义显示层级，并结合文件列表逐层浏览，快速找到最占空间的目录和文件。 #### 空间变化 磁盘空间突然少了？开启扫描记录后，对比同一磁盘或文件夹的两次扫描，就能看到哪些文件和文件夹的占用发生了变化、变化了多少。清理后再扫一次，还能确认空间是从哪里腾出来的。 > **隐私与安全** ### 5. 隐私清理 清理浏览记录、搜索记录、Cookie、最近使用项目和剪贴板内容，减少浏览器、应用和系统留下的使用痕迹，降低个人隐私泄露的风险。 > **系统工具** ### 6. 应用卸载与残留清理 卸载应用时一并清理相关缓存、设置和残留文件，避免应用删了，空间却没真正释放出来。对可能包含个人文件的内容会谨慎处理，降低误删风险。 ### 7. 启动项管理 关闭不必要的启动项，减少开机等待和后台资源占用；需要时可随时恢复。 ### 8. 系统优化 调整影响性能或日常使用的不必要设置，兼顾性能、隐私和个人习惯，让系统更流畅、更顺手。 ### 9. 系统维护 修复搜索异常、图标错乱、无声或网络连接异常等常见问题，无需手动排查或输入复杂命令。 ### 10. 右键菜单（Windows） 按菜单位置或所属应用查看条目，可禁用、恢复或删除可管理的菜单项，也能按文件类型分别调整，让右键菜单更清爽。 还可添加复制路径、打开终端等常用操作，以及系统工具入口。 > **操作记录** ### 11. 操作历史 每次清理和系统调整都有记录，方便查看释放了多少空间、哪些操作已完成，以及是否有需要处理的问题。 ## 运行状态与内存管理 实时监控 CPU、GPU、内存、网络和磁盘状态，了解资源占用情况及变化趋势。在支持的设备上，还可查看温度、功耗、电池状态和磁盘健康信息。 快速定位资源占用较高的应用，可直接退出，也可手动或自动释放内存。 无需打开主窗口，通过菜单栏、任务栏、系统托盘或桌面悬浮窗即可查看电脑状态，显示内容与外观均可自定义。 ## AI 解读 看不懂某个条目，或不确定操作后的影响？AI 解读会结合条目说明和当前扫描结果，说明用途与注意事项，帮你判断是否需要处理。深度清理内置规则、隐私清理、启动项管理、系统优化和系统维护均支持在条目旁查看。 ## 安全与规则 > [!IMPORTANT] > **MangoDisk 始终将数据安全置于清理效果之上。** > 所有清理规则和系统优化项，都必须明确安全边界并通过真实系统验证，才会纳入正式版本。 MangoDisk 默认以只读方式扫描。清理、删除、卸载或修改系统设置前，会先列出相关内容，确认后才执行；操作结果保存在历史记录中。 系统优化只执行内置且经过验证的设置项，不支持任意注册表路径、终端命令或脚本。更改后会重新读取系统状态；高风险、需要管理员权限或重启的项目会提前提示。 MangoDisk 独立维护清理规则。第三方项目仅作为线索；候选规则必须核对可靠来源、明确安全边界，并通过真实系统验证后才会收录。无法确认安全的内容不会加入规则库。 完整规则库及修改记录均公开可查：[查看 MangoDisk 清理规则库](https://github.com/harry0703/MangoDisk/tree/main/src-tauri/crates/mangodisk-core/rules)。 ## 界面预览

深度清理
清理积累的缓存、构建产物和不再需要的 AI 模型，为需要的内容腾出空间

空间分布
直观看清空间去向，快速定位占用最多的内容

空间变化
对比两次扫描，看清哪些文件和文件夹的占用增加或减少

系统监控
CPU、内存、网络和磁盘状态一目了然

大文件清理
快速锁定最占空间的文件，避免逐层翻找

 重复文件清理
安全清理重复副本，并确保每组至少保留一份
启动项管理
减少不必要的自启动程序，加快登录并降低后台占用

 应用卸载与残留清理
卸载应用并清理关联残留，释放更多磁盘空间
系统优化
一键优化性能、隐私与使用体验，让系统运行更流畅

 系统维护
快速解决常见系统问题，让电脑恢复正常
隐私清理
减少活动痕迹留存，更好地保护日常隐私
## 使用注意事项 > [!CAUTION] > > 1. 清理、彻底删除和卸载后可能无法恢复。操作前请确认所选内容，并备份重要数据。 > 2. 执行系统维护、修改启动项或系统设置前，请确认相关项目的用途和影响。 > 3. 部分系统优化可能影响系统安全、隐私、续航或更新策略。 ## 桌面版 可从 [官网下载页](https://mangodisk.app/zh/download) 或 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/harry0703/MangoDisk/releases/latest) 下载安装包，按你的系统选择安装方式。 ### macOS **系统要求：** macOS Monterey 12.5 或更高版本。 **Homebrew 安装：** ```sh brew install --cask harry0703/tap/mangodisk ``` **手动安装：** 从 [官网下载页](https://mangodisk.app/zh/download) 下载 DMG 文件，打开后将 MangoDisk 拖入“应用程序”文件夹。 ### Windows **系统要求：** 64 位 Windows 10 或更高版本。 **PowerShell 安装：** ```powershell irm https://get.mangodisk.app | iex ``` **WinGet 安装（官方源）：** ```powershell winget install --id MangoDisk.MangoDisk --exact --source winget ``` **手动安装：** 从 [官网下载页](https://mangodisk.app/zh/download) 下载 Windows 安装程序，按提示完成安装。 ### Linux **推荐系统：** Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 或更高版本，支持 x64 和 ARM64。 提供 `.deb` 和 AppImage 安装包；其他发行版能否正常运行，取决于系统库和桌面环境。 **Homebrew 安装：** 需要较新版本的 Homebrew 和桌面环境。 ```sh brew install --cask harry0703/tap/mangodisk ``` **终端安装（Debian/Ubuntu）：** 自动识别系统架构，安装对应的最新版 `.deb` 包。 ```sh curl -fsSL https://get.mangodisk.app/linux | bash ``` **手动安装：** 从 [官网下载页](https://mangodisk.app/zh/download) 选择对应架构的安装包。 - **Debian/Ubuntu**：安装对应架构的 `.deb` 包。 - **其他发行版**：可尝试 AppImage，添加执行权限后直接运行。 ## 命令行版（CLI） 适合在终端或脚本中使用，与桌面版共用同一套安全清理引擎。 ### macOS **Homebrew 安装：** ```sh brew install harry0703/tap/mangodisk-cli ``` ### Windows **PowerShell 安装：** ```powershell irm https://get.mangodisk.app/cli | iex ``` **WinGet 安装（官方源）：** ```powershell winget install --id MangoDisk.CLI --exact --source winget ``` ### Linux 暂未提供独立 CLI 预编译包，可按照下方 [从源码构建](#从源码构建) 的步骤自行构建。 ### 使用示例 安装后如果无法识别 `mangodisk` 命令，请重新打开终端，再检查版本： ```sh mangodisk --version ``` 常用命令： ```sh # 扫描并列出可清理内容，不做修改 mangodisk clean # 按桌面版的智能推荐执行清理 mangodisk clean --apply # 预览全部可选内容，不删除文件 mangodisk clean --apply --selection all --dry-run # 输出 JSON，便于脚本处理 mangodisk clean --format json --no-progress ``` `mangodisk clean` 默认只扫描，不修改文件。在非交互环境中执行清理时，还需传入 `--yes` 明确确认。查看完整选项请运行： ```sh mangodisk clean --help ``` ## 从源码构建 ### 环境要求 - Node.js 24 LTS - pnpm 11.13.1 - Stable Rust 平台依赖请参考 [Tauri 2 前置依赖说明](https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/)。 ### 获取源码并启动桌面应用 ```sh git clone https://github.com/harry0703/MangoDisk.git cd MangoDisk pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm tauri:dev ``` ### 运行完整检查 ```sh pnpm check cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p mangodisk-core ``` ### 构建桌面安装包 ```sh pnpm tauri:build ``` ### 构建 CLI ```sh pnpm cli:build ``` 本地构建产物不含正式发布版的签名、公证和更新元数据，仅供本地开发与验证。 ## 支持 MangoDisk MangoDisk 免费、开源、无广告，核心功能可依据 GPL-3.0 免费用于个人和商业用途。如果你想支持开发，并使用官方云端 AI，可以 [成为支持者](https://mangodisk.app/zh/supporter)。 ## 参与贡献 欢迎反馈问题，也欢迎贡献清理规则、代码修复和新功能。开始前请先阅读 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) 和 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)。 常规清理功能优先使用经过构建期校验的声明式 TOML 规则。规则结构、安全约束和验证方法请参阅 [`src-tauri/crates/mangodisk-core/rules/README.md`](src-tauri/crates/mangodisk-core/rules/README.md)。 提交修改前，请至少运行： ```sh pnpm check cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p mangodisk-core ``` 发现安全问题时，请按照 [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) 通过 GitHub Security Advisories 私下报告，不要创建公开 Issue。 ## 技术栈 - [Tauri 2](https://tauri.app/)：桌面运行时与系统集成 - [Rust](https://www.rust-lang.org/)：扫描、文件系统、安全校验和清理执行 - [Vue 3](https://vuejs.org/) 与 [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)：桌面交互界面 ## 许可证 MangoDisk 基于 [GNU General Public License v3.0](https://github.com/harry0703/MangoDisk/blob/main/LICENSE) 开源。第三方组件继续遵循各自的许可证。
